case_title: ENRIQUE HARDI MEZA VS. ESPERANZA AHUMADA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,000.00 FILED BY MEZA, ENRIQUE HARDI AS TO DEFENDANT AHUMADA, ESPERANZA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-08-2021 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE: $40.00 SERVED NOV-20-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT AHUMADA, ESPERANZA

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-08-2021 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-08-2021 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF ENRIQUE HARDI MEZA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ESPERANZA AHUMADA IS PRESENT. MS. AHUMADA IS ASSISTED BY SYLVIA AREBALLO, WHO STATES THAT SHE ACTED AS HER MOTHERS AGENT BETWEEN PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT AND HAS PERSONAL KNOWLEDGE OF ALL FACTS RELATING TO THIS CASE. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-08-2021 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MEZA, ENRIQUE HARDI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT AHUMADA, ESPERANZA (PREVIOUSLY TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION ON 3-8-21) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
